decisions.note: Phase 0: category_icon_data.dart moves to ui/widgets/ as planned. Import-graph verified: only non-UI consumer is categories/data/category_seeder.dart (uses CategoryIconData.resolveIcon); it already imports from a ui/ path today, so the move does not worsen layering. core/ relocation rejected to keep the phase a pure relocation faithful to the plan.
Phase 1: DismissibleBackgroundColorScheme gains an 'edit' variant (colorScheme.primary) so categories_screen's edit swipe adopts the shared DismissibleBackground; no inline exceptions remain.

Phase 2: showCurrencyPicker is fully self-contained — loads allowed codes from CurrencyPreferencesLocalStore itself (read before opening the sheet, since showModalBottomSheet doesn't inherit providers), handles the 'Configurar monedas' round-trip internally (push /settings/currency, reload snapshot, reconcile selection like the templates donor, no sheet re-open) and returns Future<String?>. Callers pass selectedCode + optional mustIncludeCode (account currency). Forms delete _allowedCurrencies state, _openCurrencyPreferencesFlow and their sheets.

Phase 3: showAccountPicker mirrors phase 2 — self-contained top-level Future<AccountModel?> showAccountPicker(context, {title, filter (default excludes type 'contact'), excludeAccountId, mustIncludeAccountId, selectedAccountId, showCurrency, showCreateRow, topAction, createRouteExtra}). Reads AccountLocalStore via context.read before opening the sheet; the create-account row handles the /accounts/new round-trip internally (push with optional createRouteExtra, reload, re-open the sheet with the fresh list); returns the account or null. ALL post-selection side effects (currency propagation, installment reset, amount sync, calculator commit) stay in callers.

Phase 3: csv_mapping_screen adopts the shared picker via a generic optional topAction row (its quick-create 'Crear "csvName" como cuenta (bank)') plus createRouteExtra to prefill /accounts/new; its unfiltered account list (contacts shown — an oversight) converges to the default contact-excluding filter; its select-inside-onTap side effect standardizes to pop-then-return.

Phase 3: the two dropdown sites stay dropdowns as documented exceptions — advanced_filters needs an 'All' option (filter context) and pending_review_sheet is a dense sheet-within-sheet with a FormField validator. advanced_filters' English labels converge to Spanish ('Account'->'Cuenta', 'All'->'Todas') per the plan's canonical-Spanish rule.

Phase 3: row chrome converges to accountIconForType always (debt's and lot's hardcoded icons removed); new selectedAccountId param renders a trailing check on the current selection (uniform improvement, none showed it before); showCurrency flag (default false) keeps lot's 'name · CODE' label as an explicit parameter.

Phase 4: TemporalFilterState interface + the canonical QuickRange/PeriodGranularity enums live in the new lib/src/ui/widgets/temporal_page_view.dart. The duplicated enum definitions in both view models are deleted; external enum consumers (transactions_screen, advanced_filters, 2 test files) update their imports explicitly (no re-exports). The widget receives the state as an explicit constructor param — TemporalFilterState implements Listenable (both VMs are ChangeNotifier) and the widget rebuilds via an internal ListenableBuilder — instead of provider generics (context.watch<T>).

Phase 4: dashboard_filter_sheet.dart and DashboardFilterViewModel move to lib/src/ui/ (consumed by statistics, cashflow and ui/screens/dashboard — 11 files outside features/dashboard/ — violating the 'features/<f>/ui/ never imports another feature's ui/' rule). ~14 import sites update; mechanical churn accepted within this phase.

Phase 5: each *_list_tab.dart is renamed (git mv) to *_list_body.dart with class *ListBody — the tab file already IS the embeddable body (diff shows the screen is identical plus Scaffold/AppBar/FAB). The screen becomes a thin Scaffold+AppBar+FAB wrapper around the body; the single tab caller (transactions_screen.dart) updates to the new class name. No new file is written from scratch and no embedded-flag widget is introduced.

Plan closed 2026-07-19: all 6 phases (0-5) completed same-day across separate sessions, final commit 2998df6. Total impact on frontend/lib across the 6 plan commits (9ed7d97..2998df6): +2,170/-3,927 = net -1,757 LOC, within the README's 1,500-2,000 estimate. Every phase verified by the verify sub-agent with 0 CRITICAL findings. Carried-over follow-ups OUTSIDE the plan: (1) pre-existing broken test statistics_category_list_row_test.dart (be4af04); (2) manual device smoke of the temporal pager + custom-range pages (phase 4) and the Plantillas/Rendimientos tabs (phase 5).
